Sub: Audio Recording of Conference call in respect of Unaudited Financial Results for the 
quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 
 
In continuation of our letters dated 20th October 2026 & 23rd October 2026 and pursuant to 
Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
the audio recording of the Conference call conducted today, on 26th October 2026 in respect of

2026, is available on the Company’s website at https://www.bharatpetroleum.in/bharat-petroleum-
for/investors/disclosure-under-regulation-46-and-62-of-sebi-lodr-regulations/financial-
performance/conference-call-recording

Yours faithfully, 
For Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited 
 
 
 
 
(V. Kala)
